facts: In Race 6 Blue Fleet: The race started with a course set at 230° in 10-12 knots. The race was shortened at the end of the second beat as the wind was now 5-6 knots. A new breeze arrived as boats were finishing. NOR 220701 rounded the leeward gate in or around 35th place and finished 66th.
conclusions: There was neither an improper action nor improper omission of the race committee. Therefore, the requirements for redress in RRS 61.4(b)(1) are not met.
